properties.name: featurify.grpc.enabled
properties.description: Whether to create the Featurify gRPC client.

properties.name: featurify.grpc.token
properties.description: Required namespace access token, without the Bearer prefix.

properties.name: featurify.grpc.timeout
properties.description: Deadline applied independently to each RPC; positive and at most one day.

properties.name: featurify.grpc.tls
properties.description: Use TLS with server certificate and hostname verification.

properties.name: featurify.grpc.trust-certificate
properties.description: Optional PEM trust certificate resource (file: or classpath:). Requires TLS; otherwise system trust roots are used.
